home.title: Home and devices
home.summary: See the state of your devices and the energy and environment readings, and control them within the rules you set.

write_scopes.name: control_device
write_scopes.title: Turn devices on or off and adjust them

write_scopes.name: unlock_door
write_scopes.title: Unlock a door or disable an alarm

home.offline: Shows the last known state, marked as old, and cannot control anything until the home is reachable again.
home.retention: Readings are kept on this Mac only, for as long as you keep them.
home.failure: A device that does not answer is reported as not answering; Atlas never assumes a command worked.

travel.title: Travel providers
travel.summary: Bring your bookings and itineraries together, and prepare a booking for you to confirm.
travel.offline: Shows what was last fetched, marked as old.
travel.retention: Itineraries are kept on this Mac only.
travel.failure: A booking that cannot be confirmed is reported as not made.

work.title: Work platforms
work.summary: Read your projects, tasks and documents, and update tasks you can change back.
work.offline: Shows what was last fetched, marked as old.
work.retention: Work content stays on this Mac and is removed when you disconnect.
work.failure: An update the service refuses is reported as refused and nothing is assumed.

shopping.title: Shopping
shopping.summary: Track orders, returns and warranty windows, and prepare a purchase for you to confirm.
shopping.offline: Shows what was last fetched, marked as old.
shopping.retention: Order history is kept on this Mac only.
shopping.failure: A purchase that cannot be confirmed is reported as not made.

messaging.title: Messaging
messaging.summary: Read and summarise messages you connect, and draft replies for you to send.
messaging.offline: Shows what was last fetched, marked as old.
messaging.retention: Messages are kept on this Mac only and removed when you disconnect.
messaging.failure: A message that cannot be sent is reported as not sent.

cloud_storage.title: Cloud storage
cloud_storage.summary: Read files you keep online. Nothing is uploaded unless you approve it.
cloud_storage.offline: Shows what was last fetched, marked as old.
cloud_storage.retention: File lists are kept on this Mac only.
cloud_storage.failure: An upload that fails is reported as not uploaded.
